findings.disposition_rationale: Hypothetical: the merged FAFF-1178 resolveAdmittedKey reports admission-missing or ledger-malformed for any run with key material and a damaged ledger; the garbled-ledger test refuses all three legs.
resolveAdmittedKey never reads the trust file (FAFF-1178 design: the caller reads it); the ungoverned-run test asserts no trust or rules call.
A GitHub PR's url always names the base repository the PR merges into, never the head fork, so the trust and rules reads target the parent.
Same premise as the fork-url finding; the PR url names the base repository.
A missing baseRefName exits 2 only when the run looks governed; gh always returns the field, and the direction is fail-closed.
The reviewer withdrew this one in its own text: trust-context-missing correctly reports not-read.
A throwing trust read now reports the attempted source; new test (commit after d4ad6800).
The shared rules read is memoised per invocation as the spec requires; attribution is per entry.
The reviewer concluded the rules read always uses the slug the trust read used; no separate defect.
